author: Pete Johnson
text: That will be air temp, if it has been in direct sun it can get a lot hotter.  Always try to have a loose sleeve covering it if you are in the sun.  Remember its stuck on your body which has a surface temp of around 30c too.  Im currently in 36c and its fine but if i leave in the sun with no cover ill get a warning.

author: Monique Tijmes-Verbeek
text: I wear my sensor on my breast in summer. Covered from the sun and under my bathing suit when I am in the pool. Living in one of the hottest places in Spain and still no problems with my sensor or insulin pump.
